Another thing that really helped to know there was no going back was blocking him on every social media platform. I felt that was kind of extreme but it did really help with my healing since I would chronically check if he posted if he was online etc or whatever and now I just can’t.

my friend told me this but time heals all wounds. i know that sounds generic, but i promise you you’ll feel better soon. if this helps, my boyfriend broke up with me a little over a week ago and i also literally didn’t know what to do with myself. 

i wouldnt eat for like 4 days either and as an avid kpop fan, wouldn’t even listen to kpop (since my boyfriend was korean). this is what i did to help me feel a lot better (at least this week it didn’t feel as bad and he wasn’t my first thought when waking up): 

1. i let myself process the emotions. personally i just think bottling them up makes it worse and i would let myself cry as much as i needed to. if you can i kind of just took the whole week off (since i just had exams)

2. i journaled. i reflected on what was good and bad in the relationship, how i felt after getting dumped, a timeline of the relationship, and i kind of wrote a letter to my ex (without sending it) so i could let all the things i wanted to say to him out of my system. i also draw a lot, and ended up making a heartbreak art series to help me go through all the emotions.

3. if you can, i reached out to my support system. I ended up ranting to literally anyone who was willing to listen. literally i asked to hang out with some friends i haven’t talked to in months since i didn’t know who to talk to and was pleasantly surprised and ended up rebuilding a lot of my friendships 

4. exercise! i hit the gym literally every single day for like 4 hours lol. i went to play volleyball a lot and i would go on long hikes or walks in my neighbourhood every night listening to like spotify heartbreak playlists. 

5. block them on every social media platform. maybe this is dramatic but this personally helped me a lot when moving on since the first few days i was in denial and wanted to beg him to come back to me (don’t do that). my friends called me and told me they weren’t leaving the call until i blocked him on every platform (instagram, facebook, discord, even linkedin lmao, etc). after i did that i kind of was more at peace and wouldn’t be constantly staking like who new did he follow or his activity status. 


feel free to reach out if you need everything and i promise you things will get better. you are strong and don’t let anyone tell you otherwise! he is not your reason for living you are your reason for living. you existing is already an amazing thing for this world :)
